sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 220. Physical damage (Dark).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Removes status ailments.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 30 for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 30 Cost.
-Target: all allies. Increases Cost recovery speed by 10 for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Serenity for 40 seconds (increases max HP, DEF, and MDEF by 100%; nullifies debuffs and Cost reduction. After the effect ends, your character's Unison gauge is filled by 100).
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases dark elemental attack by 4 for 90 seconds.

[Five Sacred Beasts] Genbu or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
